sourceTitle: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
originalTitle: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: OpenAI and ServiceNow are expanding our partnership to bring more of our models and agents into ServiceNow products and connect ServiceNow workflows with ChatGPT and Codex. Together, we’re making it easier for businesses to build applications, resolve IT requests and address security issues using AI.
blocks.en: OpenAI and ServiceNow are expanding our partnership to bring more of our models and agents into ServiceNow products and connect ServiceNow workflows with ChatGPT and Codex. Together, we’re making it easier for businesses to build applications, resolve IT requests and address security issues using AI.
blocks.zh: OpenAI 与 ServiceNow 正在深化合作，将更多 OpenAI 模型和智能体引入 ServiceNow 产品，并将 ServiceNow 工作流与 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接起来。双方正携手帮助企业更轻松地利用 AI 构建应用、处理 IT 请求并解决安全问题。

blocks.text: The expansion builds on our partnership announced in January, bringing OpenAI into more of the work ServiceNow does for its customers and within its own business.
blocks.en: The expansion builds on our partnership announced in January, bringing OpenAI into more of the work ServiceNow does for its customers and within its own business.
blocks.zh: 此次合作扩展以我们于 1 月宣布的合作伙伴关系为基础，将 OpenAI 引入 ServiceNow 为客户提供服务及开展内部业务的更多工作中。

blocks.text: Working with ServiceNow through ChatGPT
blocks.en: Working with ServiceNow through ChatGPT
blocks.zh: 通过 ChatGPT 使用 ServiceNow

blocks.text: A new ServiceNow integration will bring business context and workflow actions directly into ChatGPT, helping teams investigate issues and take the next step in the same conversation. An IT team member will be able to find similar incidents, assess the risk of a change and update a ServiceNow record without leaving ChatGPT.
blocks.en: A new ServiceNow integration will bring business context and workflow actions directly into ChatGPT, helping teams investigate issues and take the next step in the same conversation. An IT team member will be able to find similar incidents, assess the risk of a change and update a ServiceNow record without leaving ChatGPT.
blocks.zh: 全新的 ServiceNow 集成功能将把业务上下文和工作流操作直接引入 ChatGPT，帮助团队在同一段对话中排查问题并采取后续行动。IT 团队成员无需离开 ChatGPT，即可查找类似事件、评估变更风险并更新 ServiceNow 记录。

blocks.text: Customers connect ChatGPT to their own ServiceNow instance and choose which capabilities to make available. ServiceNow’s Action Fabric applies existing business rules and permissions, so the actions people can take reflect their organization’s configuration and access.
blocks.en: Customers connect ChatGPT to their own ServiceNow instance and choose which capabilities to make available. ServiceNow’s Action Fabric applies existing business rules and permissions, so the actions people can take reflect their organization’s configuration and access.
blocks.zh: 客户可将 ChatGPT 连接到自己的 ServiceNow 实例，并选择开放哪些功能。ServiceNow 的 Action Fabric 会沿用现有业务规则和权限，因此用户可执行的操作将受其组织的配置和访问权限约束。

blocks.text: ServiceNow is also previewing interactive experiences inside ChatGPT. In one example, an on-call engineer will be able to review linked monitoring alerts, recent changes and affected services, then assign the right team and work toward a fix within ChatGPT.
blocks.en: ServiceNow is also previewing interactive experiences inside ChatGPT. In one example, an on-call engineer will be able to review linked monitoring alerts, recent changes and affected services, then assign the right team and work toward a fix within ChatGPT.
blocks.zh: ServiceNow 还在预览 ChatGPT 内的交互体验。例如，值班工程师将能够在 ChatGPT 中查看相关联的监控告警、近期变更和受影响的服务，随后将任务分配给合适的团队，并推进问题解决。

blocks.text: “AI becomes more useful when people can put it to work in the systems their businesses depend on. By bringing our models together with ServiceNow’s workflows and business context, we’re helping teams build software, address security risks and put AI to work across their organizations.”
blocks.en: “AI becomes more useful when people can put it to work in the systems their businesses depend on. By bringing our models together with ServiceNow’s workflows and business context, we’re helping teams build software, address security risks and put AI to work across their organizations.”
blocks.zh: “当人们能在企业赖以运转的系统中应用 AI 时，AI 就能发挥更大的价值。通过将我们的模型与 ServiceNow 的工作流和业务上下文相结合，我们正在帮助团队开发软件、应对安全风险，并在整个组织中应用 AI。”

blocks.text: —Greg Brockman, President and Co-founder of OpenAI
blocks.en: —Greg Brockman, President and Co-founder of OpenAI
blocks.zh: —Greg Brockman，OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人

blocks.text: “When two industry-defining innovators come together, a new chapter of business reinvention begins. OpenAI is pioneering the frontier of artificial intelligence. ServiceNow is the Super Intelligence Control Tower that orchestrates, secures, and governs AI across the enterprise. Together, we are unlocking extraordinary value for our customers by turning world-class reasoning into trusted execution at global scale.”
blocks.en: “When two industry-defining innovators come together, a new chapter of business reinvention begins. OpenAI is pioneering the frontier of artificial intelligence. ServiceNow is the Super Intelligence Control Tower that orchestrates, secures, and governs AI across the enterprise. Together, we are unlocking extraordinary value for our customers by turning world-class reasoning into trusted execution at global scale.”
blocks.zh: “当两家引领行业的创新企业携手，企业变革的新篇章就此开启。OpenAI 正在开拓人工智能的前沿。ServiceNow 是超级智能控制塔，负责整个企业内 AI 的编排、安全保障与治理。我们携手将世界一流的推理能力转化为全球范围内可信赖的执行能力，为客户创造非凡价值。”

blocks.text: —Bill McDermott, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of ServiceNow

blocks.text: Powering more ServiceNow products with OpenAI
blocks.en: Powering more ServiceNow products with OpenAI
blocks.zh: 借助 OpenAI 为更多 ServiceNow 产品提供支持

blocks.text: We also plan to develop new capabilities across three areas:
blocks.en: We also plan to develop new capabilities across three areas:
blocks.zh: 我们还计划在以下三个领域开发新功能：

blocks.text: Application development: A planned Codex integration in ServiceNow’s AI Workflow Factory will help developers build applications using ServiceNow’s business context and platform capabilities. OpenAI models will also power Build Agent and Autonomous Engineer to support application development and modernization.
blocks.en: Application development: A planned Codex integration in ServiceNow’s AI Workflow Factory will help developers build applications using ServiceNow’s business context and platform capabilities. OpenAI models will also power Build Agent and Autonomous Engineer to support application development and modernization.
blocks.zh: 应用开发：ServiceNow 的 AI 工作流工厂计划集成 Codex，帮助开发者利用 ServiceNow 的业务上下文和平台能力构建应用。OpenAI 模型还将为 Build Agent 和 Autonomous Engineer 提供支持，助力应用开发与现代化升级。

blocks.text: Cybersecurity: A joint security solution will combine OpenAI’s cybersecurity capabilities with ServiceNow’s asset, identity and business context to help teams investigate vulnerabilities, prioritize risks and coordinate remediation.
blocks.en: Cybersecurity: A joint security solution will combine OpenAI’s cybersecurity capabilities with ServiceNow’s asset, identity and business context to help teams investigate vulnerabilities, prioritize risks and coordinate remediation.
blocks.zh: 网络安全：双方将联合推出安全解决方案，把 OpenAI 的网络安全能力与 ServiceNow 的资产、身份和业务上下文相结合，帮助团队排查漏洞、确定风险处理优先级并协调修复工作。

blocks.text: Voice: An OpenAI-powered experience in ServiceNow’s Super Intelligence Control Tower will let people describe an AI use case aloud, helping populate assessment fields and gather missing information through follow-up questions.
blocks.en: Voice: An OpenAI-powered experience in ServiceNow’s Super Intelligence Control Tower will let people describe an AI use case aloud, helping populate assessment fields and gather missing information through follow-up questions.
blocks.zh: 语音：ServiceNow 的超级智能控制塔将推出由 OpenAI 提供支持的体验，让用户通过语音描述 AI 用例，帮助填写评估字段，并通过追问补全缺失信息。

blocks.text: Bringing ChatGPT Work and Codex to all ServiceNow employees
blocks.en: Bringing ChatGPT Work and Codex to all ServiceNow employees
blocks.zh: 向 ServiceNow 全体员工提供 ChatGPT 工作和 Codex

blocks.text: ServiceNow plans to give all employees access to ChatGPT Work and Codex, expanding beyond its engineering organization. Engineers can use Codex to explore codebases, make changes and run tests, while teams across the business can use ChatGPT Work in their day-to-day work. ServiceNow also plans to use OpenAI capabilities in its internal security work. OpenAI is also using ServiceNow workflows in our own operations, supported by the Super Intelligence Control Tower.
blocks.en: ServiceNow plans to give all employees access to ChatGPT Work and Codex, expanding beyond its engineering organization. Engineers can use Codex to explore codebases, make changes and run tests, while teams across the business can use ChatGPT Work in their day-to-day work. ServiceNow also plans to use OpenAI capabilities in its internal security work. OpenAI is also using ServiceNow workflows in our own operations, supported by the Super Intelligence Control Tower.
blocks.zh: ServiceNow 计划将 ChatGPT 工作和 Codex 的使用范围从工程部门扩展至全体员工。工程师可以使用 Codex 探索代码库、修改代码并运行测试，企业各部门的团队则可以在日常工作中使用 ChatGPT 工作。ServiceNow 还计划在内部安全工作中使用 OpenAI 的能力。OpenAI 也正在超级智能控制塔的支持下，将 ServiceNow 工作流用于自身运营。

blocks.text: Availability
blocks.en: Availability
blocks.zh: 推出时间

blocks.text: The ServiceNow MCP plugin is available in the OpenAI marketplace today, with enhanced capabilities expected by the end of 2026. Voice capabilities in the Super Intelligence Control Tower are expected in the first quarter of 2027. The OpenAI-powered security capabilities are expected to enter early access in January 2027, with general availability planned for the second quarter of 2027. Codex in AI Workflow Factory is expected to be available in 2027.
blocks.en: The ServiceNow MCP plugin is available in the OpenAI marketplace today, with enhanced capabilities expected by the end of 2026. Voice capabilities in the Super Intelligence Control Tower are expected in the first quarter of 2027. The OpenAI-powered security capabilities are expected to enter early access in January 2027, with general availability planned for the second quarter of 2027. Codex in AI Workflow Factory is expected to be available in 2027.
blocks.zh: ServiceNow MCP 插件现已在 OpenAI 市场上线，增强功能预计将于 2026 年底前推出。超级智能控制塔的语音功能预计将于 2027 年第一季度推出。由 OpenAI 提供支持的安全功能预计将于 2027 年 1 月开放抢先体验，并计划于 2027 年第二季度正式发布。AI 工作流工厂中的 Codex 预计将于 2027 年推出。
